statement: The stage-1 term list for this label contains notation templates ("step-verify-nnn-nnn", "tv-f-nnn", "vc-1..vc-12") that appear to be searched as literal strings: every raw hit with term_index 6 is the literal "TV-F-nnn" (S1438, S1439, S1441, S1540), and the templates step-verify-nnn-nnn and vc-1..vc-12 produced no raw hit. Row sources whose text carries concrete instances (S1521 "artifact: TV-F-042 … TV-F-055"; S1524 "STEP-VERIFY-141-158" and "## KnowledgeOS theory-verification programme · end-of-series seam") have no stage-1 hit for this label. Stage-1 recall for labels whose notations are templates is therefore bounded by literal template occurrence, a false-negative mechanism in the census. For this label the effect on resolutions is nil (all row sources were read whole at step 1 and none supplies a type signature), but a GENUINELY-UNDEFINED-AFTER-CENSUS elsewhere could rest on it.

The exact letter-to-invariant binding and the type of the operands cannot be read from R1.

statement: Self-confirming experiment pattern: per-band tallies (≈350 boxed verdicts in 067-082 with 0 Expected/Result divergences, VF-14; 636 experiments / 100% PASS in 083-100; 126/126 in 101-104; ≈470 per-experiment PASS tokens in 101-120; ≈1,490 / ≈1,433 PASS in 067-120; ≈1,600 then ≈1,900 corpus-wide at ≈99% PASS) with zero executions. Inference drawn: a suite with a near-100% pass rate, no negative control and no experiment able to diverge from its own Expected is 'evidence the suite cannot fail, not evidence of correctness'. Four genuine falsification passes are identified (steps 169, 175, 178, 181).

statement: A no-silent-repair rule recurs across the programme's artifacts from its proposal to its latest mandate (S1413 "neither Claude session should be allowed to unilaterally change the other"; S1518 "No silent repair applied."; S1540 "No silent repair (absolute)"; S1566 "Do not promote candidate theory to verified theory."). In S1551 the programme extends the rule to its own claims ("a claim is indexed to the moment of observation — applies to the programme's own claims"), and in S1444 it changes its objective from producing registers to constructing the final theory, with verification as the justification mechanism (timeline CHANGES-DEFINITION). The rule stays stable while the objective changes.
